name: Loch Modan
summary: Loch Modan's great lake stands above the Wetlands, held back by the Stonewrought Dam. Around Thelsamar, troggs threaten the southern valleys, kobolds work the mines, and ogres hold the northeast highlands.

sections.title: A Highland Jewel
sections.body: Loch Modan's lake fills a green valley east of Dun Morogh. Pines and birches climb toward rugged peaks, and the Stonewrought Dam spans the northern rim. The dwarven town of Thelsamar draws mountaineers, hunters, and miners. Copper and tin run through the surrounding hills.

sections.title: Unearthed Terrors and Invasions
sections.body: Broken catapults and ballistae on the lake bed recall the Second War. The orcish Horde occupied Loch Modan then, until the dwarves drove them out. More recently, dwarven excavations opened underground chambers and released savage troggs. Their tribes, led by chieftains, overran the southern canyons of Stonesplinter Valley and the Valley of Kings. The Ironforge Mountaineers fight to defend the trade routes.

sections.title: Plots in the Shadows
sections.body: Troggs and the ogres of Mo'grosh Stronghold threaten the valley. Investigations into local sabotage point to the treacherous Dark Iron dwarves, who came through the burning passes to the south. Dark Iron infiltrators target dwarven blastpowder reserves and harbor designs against the Stonewrought Dam.

faq.q: What holds the lake back from flooding the Wetlands?
aliases: why does loch modan have a dam
faq.answer: The Stonewrought Dam holds back the entire Loch. Dwarven engineers maintain it carefully, since a breach would wash out the Wetlands' lower marshlands to the north.

faq.q: Where did all the troggs come from?
faq.answer: Dwarven explorers and miners broke into underground chambers deep in the mountains. Savage troggs poured out, swarmed to the surface, and established camps in the valleys.

faq.q: What is the primary Alliance settlement in the zone?
faq.answer: Thelsamar, on the western bluffs, is the main Alliance town and travel hub. Its Stoutlager Inn, tradesfolk, and gryphon masters connect travelers to Ironforge and beyond.
Brute ogres hold Mo'grosh Stronghold in the northeast mountains. They descended into the valley and built a fortified outpost that terrorizes nearby hunters and travelers.

faq.q: What happened to Ironband's Excavation Site?
faq.answer: Troggs pouring from underground chambers overran Prospector Ironband's archaeological dig. The team abandoned its work and fought to secure its remaining supplies.

faq.q: Can you travel from Loch Modan to the Badlands or Searing Gorge?
faq.answer: Yes. Footpaths lead south through the mountains to the arid Badlands. The Stonewrought Pass through the Valley of Kings leads southwest to the volcanic crags of Searing Gorge.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see Loch Modan's unmatched stonework and the dangerous ancient history your people keep uncovering beneath the stone.
At the Farstrider Lodge on the southeastern ridges, trackers gather to hunt bears, crocolisks, and mountain buzzards.
Loch Modan's hills, quarries, and trogg-infested caves hold accessible veins of copper, tin, and silver.
Loch Modan guards the route between Dun Morogh and the northern roads to the Wetlands, helping defend Ironforge's territory.
